en.headline: Truck collides with empty Light Rail train in Tuen Mun
en.dek: The MTR diverted three routes and ran free shuttle buses after the 10:30 collision at Lung Mun Road and Wu Chui Road; services began returning to normal by 11:03.
body: A truck collided with a Light Rail train carrying no passengers at the junction of Lung Mun Road and Wu Chui Road in Tuen Mun at about 10:30 this morning. No injuries were reported, according to accounts from the scene.

The MTR Corporation said the accident disrupted services at the Melody Garden stop. Routes 610, 615 and 615P were diverted and skipped stops between Tuen Mun Ferry Pier and the Light Rail Depot. The operator arranged free shuttle buses between Tuen Mun Ferry Pier and Sam Shing, and between Butterfly and Siu Hei.

The Transport Department closed some lanes at the junction while the incident was being handled, leading to heavy traffic in the area. The MTR announced at 11:03 that the situation had been cleared and Light Rail services were gradually returning to normal.

zh.headline: 屯門龍門路貨車撞無乘客輕鐵 三條路綫一度改道
zh.dek: 早上約10時30分湖翠路交界發生碰撞，港鐵安排免費接駁巴士，至11時03分宣布事件處理完畢，服務逐步回復正常。
body: 今早約10時30分，一輛貨車在屯門龍門路與湖翠路交界與一列沒有載客的輕鐵列車相撞。現場消息指事件中無人受傷。
港鐵表示，意外影響美樂站服務，610、615及615P綫改道，不停屯門碼頭站至輕鐵車廠站。公司已安排免費接駁巴士，來往屯門碼頭及三聖站，以及蝴蝶及兆禧站。
運輸署在處理期間封閉交界部分行車線，當地交通繁忙。港鐵於早上11時03分宣布事件已處理，輕鐵服務逐步回復正常。
